name: Beige Channel Tufted Divan Bed with Storage and Mattress
description: A complete bed unit comprising a beige upholstered divan base with two integrated storage drawers, a matching tall channel-tufted headboard, and a white and black mattress.

name: Modern Curved Upholstered Platform Bed
description: A contemporary platform bed featuring a generously curved headboard and footboard, fully upholstered in a dark navy blue fabric. The integrated base sits low to the ground, supported by subtle, light-toned round wooden feet.

name: Modern Wooden Platform Bed with Cane and Upholstered Headboard
description: A contemporary low-profile platform bed featuring a light-toned wooden frame and a distinctive headboard. The headboard combines a top section of natural cane webbing with lower vertically paneled upholstered sections in a neutral gray fabric. The bed is styled with light-colored bedding, including a textured quilt and a selection of decorative throw pillows.

name: Modern Black Leather Upholstered Platform Bed
description: A modern platform bed featuring a low-profile design and complete black leather upholstery. The headboard is padded and appears to be split into two sections, contributing to a comfortable, relaxed aesthetic. The bed frame extends flush with the mattress, supported by discreet, slender metal feet, giving it a floating appearance. The bedding consists of white pillows and a light gray duvet.

name: Traditional Dark Wood Panel Bed Frame
description: A dark wood bed frame featuring a tall, arched headboard with decorative carved trim and recessed panels, a matching footboard, and sturdy side rails supporting an integrated slat system for mattress support. The wood has a rich, dark brown finish.

name: Burgundy Velvet Upholstered Platform Bed with Scalloped Headboard
description: A luxurious platform bed featuring a distinctive scalloped headboard and fully upholstered in a plush burgundy velvet. The low-profile frame supports a mattress, and the bed is dressed with beige bedding, complemented by burgundy and light beige throw pillows and a burgundy blanket. The headboard's design consists of vertical, rounded fluted panels, giving it an Art Deco-inspired or glamorous contemporary aesthetic.

name: Natural Wood Children's Bunk Bed
description: A light natural wood bunk bed designed for children. It features a straightforward, rectangular frame with two stacked sleeping platforms. Each bed includes slatted guardrails for safety, with the top bunk having a full set of rails on all open sides, and the bottom bunk having a partial rail at the foot. An integrated ladder with flat steps is built into the side frame, providing access to the top bunk. The wood grain is visible, suggesting a light-colored solid wood construction, and the overall design is simple and functional. Both bunks are fitted with plain white mattresses.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Platform Bed
description: A low-profile contemporary platform bed featuring a fully upholstered frame with rounded corners, topped with a mattress, white bedding, and layered blankets.

name: Traditional Dark Wood Four-Poster Bed Frame
description: A traditional four-poster bed frame crafted from dark-stained wood, featuring prominently turned posts at each corner and a solid, slightly curved headboard. The bed is dressed with light-colored bedding, including a mattress, two pillows, a duvet, and a pale green throw blanket draped across the foot of the bed. The frame is substantial, indicating a durable construction style.

name: Upholstered Twin Platform Bed with Curved Headboard
description: A modern, minimalist upholstered twin platform bed featuring a gently curved headboard and a low-profile frame. The entire bed frame, including the headboard and side rails, is covered in a light beige, textured fabric. The design is clean and contemporary, providing an integrated look without exposed legs.

name: Upholstered Scalloped Channeled Platform Bed
description: An upholstered platform bed frame featuring a distinctive scalloped headboard and footboard, covered in a light blue channeled fabric.

name: Modern Wooden Platform Bed with Paneled Upholstered Headboard
description: A contemporary platform bed featuring a clean-lined wooden frame and an integrated, vertically paneled upholstered headboard in a deep maroon color. The bed is styled with modern bedding and accent pillows, set against a two-tone wall.

name: Upholstered Platform Bed with Curved Headboard and Sculpted Wood Legs
description: A contemporary upholstered platform bed featuring a high, rounded headboard and a fabric-covered frame. The bed is supported by distinctive sculpted wooden feet. It is presented with white bedding and two sets of throw pillows.

name: Oak Platform Bed with Cane Headboard and Tapered Legs
description: A modern platform bed frame crafted from light-toned wood, featuring a distinctive rounded headboard with natural cane (rattan) webbing and elegantly tapered legs. The frame includes integrated wooden slats for mattress support.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Platform Bed with Organic Headboard and Matching Tufted Bench
description: A contemporary upholstered platform bed featuring a distinctive organic-shaped headboard, paired with a matching tufted bench. Both pieces are covered in a textured, light beige fabric, likely a boucle or similar weave, providing a soft and inviting aesthetic. The bed frame is fully upholstered, creating a cohesive and plush appearance.

name: Modern Platform Bed with Upholstered Headboard and Matching Foot Bench
description: A modern platform bed with a split upholstered headboard in white, a sleek gloss black frame, and a matching upholstered foot bench with geometric black legs. The bed is dressed with white bedding.

name: Modern Upholstered Panel Bed
description: A modern bed featuring a dark brown wood frame with light beige upholstered panels on both the headboard and a low-profile footboard. The design is minimalist with clean lines, presenting a contemporary aesthetic suitable for various bedroom interiors. A white mattress and pillow are present, indicating a complete bed setup.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Platform Bed with Layered Curved Headboard
description: A contemporary upholstered platform bed featuring a distinctive layered and curved headboard design. The entire frame and headboard are covered in a light beige fabric, presenting a soft and inviting aesthetic. The bed has a low-profile base, suggesting a platform construction where the mattress sits directly on the frame without requiring a box spring. It is dressed with light-colored bedding and complemented by an array of decorative pillows in varying shades of beige and brown, alongside a brown throw blanket draped across the foot of the bed.

name: Upholstered Winged Headboard Platform Bed with Mattress
description: A modern upholstered platform bed featuring a curved, winged headboard, presented with a mattress. The bed frame and headboard are entirely covered in a light beige or off-white textured fabric. The headboard exhibits two subtle vertical seams, suggesting a paneled design. The accompanying mattress is white with distinct black piping along its edges and displays a 'habitat' brand label.

name: Carved Wooden Canopy Bed with Cane Headboard
description: A traditional wooden canopy bed featuring an intricately carved headboard with cane webbing, supported by four turned and fluted posts that extend upwards to form a canopy frame. The bed frame is constructed from a rich, dark brown wood, showcasing visible grain. The design incorporates both classic craftsmanship and natural textures, suitable for various bedroom aesthetics.

name: Modern Upholstered Channel-Tufted Platform Bed with Matching Bench
description: A modern upholstered platform bed featuring a tall, channel-tufted headboard and frame, accented with gold-finished metal trim, accompanied by a coordinating channel-tufted upholstered bench.

name: Modern Upholstered Platform Bed with Integrated Nightstands
description: A modern upholstered bed featuring a distinctive, oversized headboard with a wide, curvilinear shape. The headboard is upholstered in a light grey textured fabric and curves around the sides, partially enclosing two integrated, round nightstands with dark wood veneer, each featuring two drawers. The bed frame itself is a low-profile platform design, also upholstered in the same light grey fabric, giving it a sleek and contemporary appearance. The bedding includes white sheets, pillows, and a brown throw.

name: Kids Pink Velvet Bunny Bed
description: A pink velvet upholstered child's bed featuring a headboard shaped like bunny ears with a small bow detail. The bed frame has integrated low side rails on both sides of the mattress, providing security for a child. The mattress is visible and has a patterned white and gray cover. The overall design is whimsical and suitable for a child's bedroom.

name: Upholstered Bed Frame with Curved Wood Headboard
description: A bed frame featuring a distinctive upholstered headboard and matching upholstered side rails and footboard. The headboard has an undulating top edge and is framed by a light-toned, possibly distressed, wooden border. The upholstered sections are covered in a textured reddish-brown fabric. A white mattress is visible within the frame.

name: Upholstered Platform Bed with Integrated Headboard
description: A contemporary platform bed featuring a fully upholstered frame and an integrated, slightly padded headboard, all covered in a textured light beige fabric. The design is minimalist, offering a clean and streamlined look suitable for modern bedrooms. The bed includes a mattress support system, eliminating the need for a box spring. Two white pillows and a white fitted sheet are shown on the bed.

name: Modern Dark Brown Leather Platform Bed with Integrated Side Tables
description: A modern dark brown leather platform bed featuring a wide, wrap-around headboard that seamlessly integrates two cylindrical side tables. The low-profile bed frame is also upholstered in dark brown leather. The bed is adorned with light grey bedding and two bolster pillows with a cowhide-like pattern.

name: Upholstered Channel-Tufted Bed Frame
description: A modern upholstered bed frame featuring a distinctive channel-tufted design on the headboard, footboard, and side rails. The frame is finished in a light gray fabric and includes a wooden slat system for mattress support, eliminating the need for a box spring.

name: Upholstered Platform Bed with Layered Bohemian Bedding
description: A low-profile upholstered platform bed is presented with a complete, layered bedding ensemble. The bed frame itself features a subtle beige fabric upholstery. The bedding includes a fitted sheet and duvet cover in a light teal shade, topped with a medium teal blanket. A large, intricately crocheted or knitted throw in a cream color with fringe accents is draped over the teal blanket. The pillows are arranged in layers, starting with two cream-colored shams with braided trim, followed by two solid teal pillows, a decorative teal pillow with an ornate pattern, and a cream and teal striped lumbar pillow. The overall aesthetic is clean and inviting.

name: Art Deco Macassar Ebony Radial Headboard Bed
description: A luxurious bed featuring a prominent semi-circular headboard crafted with a radial pattern of dark wood veneer, possibly Macassar ebony. The low-profile platform bed frame also utilizes matching dark wood veneer with a vertical grain. The mattress and bolster pillows are upholstered in a distinctive brown and beige animal print fabric, resembling tiger stripes, contributing to an overall Art Deco or Hollywood Regency aesthetic.
